title: host.massadd
description: This method allows to simultaneously add one or more related objects to all the given hosts.

hosts.description: Hosts to be updated. The hosts must have the hostid property defined.

groups.description: Host groups to add the hosts to. The host groups must have the groupid property defined.

dns.description: DNS name used by the interface. Can be empty if the connection is made via IP.

ip.description: IP address used by the interface. Can be empty if the connection is made via DNS.

main.description: Whether the interface is used as default on the host. Possible values are: 0 - not default; 1 - default.

port.description: Port number used by the interface. Can contain user macros.

type.description: Interface type. Possible values are: 1 - agent; 2 - SNMP; 3 - IPMI; 4 - JMX.

useip.description: Whether the connection should be made via IP. Possible values are: 0 - connect using host DNS name; 1 - connect using host IP address for this host interface.

details.description: Additional object for interface. Required if interface type is SNMP.

version.description: SNMP interface version. Possible values are: 1 - SNMPv1; 2 - SNMPv2c; 3 - SNMPv3

bulk.description: Whether to use bulk SNMP requests. Possible values are: 0 - don't use bulk requests; 1 - use bulk requests.

community.description: SNMP community (required). Used only by SNMPv1 and SNMPv2 interfaces.

securityname.description: SNMPv3 security name. Used only by SNMPv3 interfaces.

securitylevel.description: SNMPv3 security level. Used only by SNMPv3 interfaces. Possible values are: 0 - noAuthNoPriv; 1 - authNoPriv; 2 - authPriv.

authpassphrase.description: SNMPv3 authentication passphrase. Used only by SNMPv3 interfaces.

privpassphrase.description: SNMPv3 privacy passphrase. Used only by SNMPv3 interfaces.

authprotocol.description: SNMPv3 authentication protocol. Used only by SNMPv3 interfaces. Possible values are: 0 - MD5; 1 - SHA1; 2 - SHA224; 3 - SHA256; 4 - SHA384; 5 - SHA512.

privprotocol.description: SNMPv3 privacy protocol. Used only by SNMPv3 interfaces. Possible values are: 0 - DES; 1 - AES128; 2 - AES192; 3 - AES256; 4 - AES192C; 5 - AES256C.

contextname.description: SNMPv3 context name. Used only by SNMPv3 interfaces.

interfaces.description: Interfaces to be created for the hosts.

type.description: Type of macro. Possible values: 0 - Text macro; 1 - Secret macro; 2 - Vault secret.

macros.description: User macros to be created for the hosts.

templates.description: Templates to be linked to the hosts. The templates must have the templateid property defined.
